description.fun: A curious little octopus that investigates everything by punching it. Unlike real octopuses it isn't very bright, about as smart as a three-year-old, and its knobbly tentacles are useless for gripping but perfect for pummelling. If one tears off it doesn't mind, because it knows it'll grow back.
description.guide: A small Fighting-type octopus Pokémon that investigates things by punching them with its tentacles. Clobbopus lives underwater but comes onto land to find food. It evolves into Grapploct after learning Taunt.
description.tagline: A curious octopus that punches whatever it wants to know about

description.fun: An octopus of pure muscle that comes ashore looking for a fight, then heads home to the sea once the battle's done. Its prized tentacles pin opponents so firmly that not even monstrously strong Pokémon can wrestle free, and the one around its waist looks like a black belt. Its feud with Golisopod has no fixed winner: whoever wins eats.
description.guide: The evolution of Clobbopus, a muscular octopus Pokémon styled after jujitsu fighters and masked wrestlers. Grapploct comes onto land to test its grappling skills, then returns to the sea.
description.tagline: A muscle-bound octopus with a black belt in grappling
